task.description:
Re-gate after CODE-DESIGNER rework1 — verify all 4 validator failures from step-01b are now resolved.

Re-check all 5 criteria:
1. AC coverage for OBP-01, OBP-02, OBP-03, DDL-03
2. No implementation code (E050 code blocks ≤40 lines each)
3. Complete enough for BACKEND-DEV
4. No contradictions between designs
5. Open questions formally resolved or declared out-of-scope

Also verify:
- Y111 BLOCKER: migration_number in templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml no longer collides with existing migrations/
- Y132 MAJOR: all test_cases in the migration YAML have requirement_ref, act, assertions

Return PASS if all issues are resolved. Return FAIL with specific remaining gaps if not.

result.summary: 3 of 4 rework1 fixes verified; 1 MAJOR issue remains. Y111 FIXED (migration_number 1167, no collision with existing 1166). E050 FIXED (all 4 design markdown files pass lint with exit 0; all code blocks <=40 lines). OQ FIXED (all 3 open questions formally resolved or declared out-of-scope in Resolved Open Questions sections). Y132 STILL FAILING: assertions fields in all 4 test_cases in templates/specs/obp-01-plat-outbox-gate-depth-ts.migration.yaml are YAML lists (e.g. '- row_count: 1') instead of block scalar strings. Both lint_design_artefact.py and codegen_migration.py --dry-run crash with AttributeError/'expected string or bytes-like object' (exit 1). All other migration YAMLs in templates/specs/ use 'assertions: |' block scalar with '// CUSTOM:' placeholder text. CODE-DESIGNER must convert each assertions list to a block scalar string.

issues.description: All 4 test_cases have 'assertions' formatted as a YAML list of dicts (e.g. '- row_count: 1', '- column: is_nullable\n  value: "NO"'). The migration spec schema requires assertions to be a block scalar string (assertions: |) containing a '// CUSTOM:' placeholder. Both lint_design_artefact.py (TypeError: expected string or bytes-like object, got 'list') and codegen_migration.py --dry-run (AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'rstrip') crash with exit 1. Fix: change each assertions field from a list to a string block scalar, e.g. 'assertions: |\n  // CUSTOM: assert row_count=1 and is_nullable=NO for depth_refreshed_at column.' See obp-04-plat-outbox-gate.migration.yaml for the correct format.

result.next_action: Route back to CODE-DESIGNER for rework2: fix assertions format in migration YAML (MAJOR Y132 remaining).
